items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: That's where the, well as they say the Hattons was. Plus Storyville, which was the, where Lula White and all this was.

ctx.x: What about the View of Korea in those days at Bourbon Street and all that? When did Bourbon Street start booming? Do you remember?

No, I sure can't dig. There was nothing when you were a kid? No, sure you had a lot of these. That's where the, well as they say the Hattons was. Plus Storyville, which was the, where Lula White and all this was. Yeah. But the joints were still there because you can look at the old Absinthe House and see how old that thing is. Yeah. So that's part of it.
There were some joints anywhere in the Bourbon Street. Sure there were some joints.
